title: Kenyan Vegetable Wrap
description: A flavorful and healthy Kenyan-inspired wrap filled with sautéed vegetables and served with a tangy slaw.

ingredients.name: Tangy slaw (cabbage, carrots, apple cider vinegar)

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced vegetables and cook for 4-5 minutes, or until tender.
Warm the wrap in the microwave for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spooning the vegetable mixture onto the center of the wrap.
Top with the tangy slaw and drizzle with lime juice.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
